Washington, DC 20426

Re:       PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., Docket No. EL25-49-000, et al.
          Compliance Filing in Docket No. ER26-1479-000

Dear Secretary Reese:

       This letter, being served on all parties to the above-referenced proceeding, confirms
that PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. (“PJM”) submitted on February 23, 2026 a filing in
Docket No. ER26-1479-000 (Accession No. 20260223-5181) in compliance with the
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s 60-day compliance directives in the December
18, 2025 order. 1 PJM requested a placeholder effective date of 12/31/9998. On February
24, 2026, the Commission set 5 pm ET on March 16, 2026 for comments on this filing.

                                                    Respectfully submitted,

                                                     /s/ Mark J. Stanisz
